verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail offers mail-handling automation rules and Zapier/API integrations that could enable background automations, but there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific autonomous automation, scheduling, or workflow orchestration beyond basic mail rules. missing for 10: documented autonomous/agentic automation examples, API schema/OpenAPI docs (probes show 404s), evidence of persistent background-running automations beyond simple mail-handling rules.
